input.summary: Remove the three-year take-or-pay commitment; fees payable for Services ordered/used only
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right, and it contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment. We have replaced it so Fees are payable only for Services ordered and used; if a commitment is commercially necessary, we can discuss one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice and trued up rather than penalised.

ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer makes no minimum purchase or volume commitment. Customer is obliged to pay only for Services ordered under an Order Form and actually used, and no take-or-pay, shortfall, or similar charge applies.
